current_roster.title: Canine Osteosarcoma Vaccine Trial
current_roster.institution: University of Queensland, School of Veterinary Science
current_roster.description: Experimental vaccine trial for dogs recently diagnosed with appendicular osteosarcoma. Two vaccine formulations being assessed. Dogs must be proceeding to surgery with no evidence of metastasis. All breeds eligible.
current_roster.keywords: osteosarcoma bone cancer vaccine immunotherapy surgery tumour tumor UQ Queensland Gatton

current_roster.title: Feline Diabetes Treatment and Monitoring Studies
current_roster.institution: University of Queensland, School of Veterinary Science
current_roster.description: Three concurrent studies for diabetic cats and cats in diabetic remission. Two studies investigate exenatide (Bydureon), a long-acting synthetic drug. A third evaluates continuous glucose monitors that provide readings without needles. No cost to owners for diagnostics, study drugs, or monitoring.
current_roster.keywords: diabetes diabetic cat feline exenatide Bydureon glucose monitor insulin remission UQ Queensland Gatton endocrine

current_roster.title: Canine Osteoarthritis Pain Management Study
current_roster.institution: University of Sydney, Veterinary Teaching Hospital
current_roster.description: Evaluating a novel anti-inflammatory compound for management of chronic osteoarthritis pain in dogs aged 5 years and older. Multi-site, placebo-controlled study design.
current_roster.keywords: osteoarthritis arthritis joint pain NSAID anti-inflammatory Sydney Camden NSW orthopaedic

current_roster.title: Canine Cognitive Decline and Gut Microbiome Study
current_roster.description: Longitudinal observational study examining the relationship between gut microbiome composition and cognitive function in ageing dogs. Involves stool collection and cognitive assessments over 12 months.
current_roster.keywords: cognitive decline dementia ageing aging microbiome gut brain Melbourne Werribee VIC neurology senior elderly

current_roster.title: Antimicrobial Prescribing in Companion Animal UTI
current_roster.institution: University of Melbourne, Asia-Pacific Centre for Animal Health
current_roster.description: Prospective intervention study examining antimicrobial prescribing behaviour for urinary tract disease in dogs and cats. Evaluating the impact of free culture and susceptibility testing and decision support tools on antibiotic use in general practice clinics across metropolitan Melbourne.
current_roster.keywords: antimicrobial antibiotic resistance UTI urinary tract infection culture susceptibility prescribing stewardship Melbourne VIC cat

current_roster.title: Immunotherapy for Solid Tumours in Dogs
current_roster.description: Clinical research into immunotherapeutic approaches for solid tumours in companion animals. Led by the oncology service at The Animal Hospital at Murdoch University, with particular focus on novel checkpoint inhibitor combinations.
current_roster.keywords: immunotherapy cancer tumour tumor oncology Murdoch Perth WA checkpoint inhibitor solid

current_roster.title: Rapamycin and Canine Ageing, Expression of Interest
current_roster.description: PetTrials is tracking interest in Australian participation for rapamycin-based longevity studies in dogs, following the success of the US Dog Aging Project TRIAD trial. Register your interest to help demonstrate demand for Australian-based lifespan extension research.
current_roster.keywords: rapamycin ageing aging longevity lifespan extension Dog Aging Project mTOR senior elderly
